headline: 法文學獎爆AI寫作爭議
context: 海地裔加拿大作家Thélyson Orélien的小說《C'était ça ou mourir》，原本入圍法國龔固爾文學獎（Prix Goncourt）長名單，卻因匿名網路帳號指控該書「幾乎全由AI寫成」，遭主辦單位撤下。龔固爾學院表示，此舉是為了維護獎項與學院的誠信。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Thélyson Orélien had been in the running to win a top literary prize before the AI claim emerged on social media The organisers of France’s most prestigious literary prize said they had removed a critically acclaimed novel by a Canadian-Haitian writer from the longlist after an anonymous online account claimed the book was “almost entirely” written by AI. The Académie Goncourt, a Paris-based literary organisation, said on Friday its decision to withdraw Thélyson Orélien’s novel C’était ça ou mourir (It Was That or Die) was “driven by the desire to preserve the integrity of the Goncourt prize and the academy itself, whose central role is to promote and honour literature written by women and men”. sources.title: Novelist accused of using AI to write book removed from French prize list

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: “It Was Either That Or Die,” by the Haitian-Canadian author Thélyson Orélien, was the hit of the French literary season. Now it has been pulled from the shortlist for a prestigious prize.
sources.title: His Novel Had a Shot at a Top Book Prize. Then Someone Ran an A.I. Test.

claim_trace.claim: 龔固爾學院因AI寫作指控，將Thélyson Orélien的小說自長名單撤下。

voice_text: 一本入圍法國重要文學獎的小說，被指控是AI寫的，結果直接被拉下名單。海地裔加拿大作家Thélyson Orélien的作品《C'était ça ou mourir》，原本在龔固爾獎長名單上，卻有匿名網路帳號指控這本書幾乎全由AI寫成。主辦單位龔固爾學院表示，撤下這本書，是為了維護獎項跟學院本身的誠信。
